from.place: proof, first paragraph: finite separable field extensions are classified by finite continuous G-sets

title: Finite separable field extensions and finite continuous G-sets
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K^sep a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], and G = Gal(K^sep/K) with its Krull topology. For every finite separable extension L/K (finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]), the set Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L) is a finite transitive discrete continuous G-set. For every K-embedding sigma: L \to K^sep, the stabilizer of the corresponding point is Gal(K^sep/sigma(L)). Conversely, every finite transitive discrete continuous G-set is isomorphic to one of this form. Moreover, for finite separable extensions L/K and L'/K, the map Hom_K(Spec L, Spec L') \to Hom_G(Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L), Hom_K(Spec K^sep, Spec L')) induced by precomposition with geometric points is a bijection.
